annotations.title: Get one red-list entry in full

description: Everything FDA prints for one red-list entry: the firm name and address, the import alert and its title, the product code and description, FDA's stated reason (the Notes block — the actual finding, e.g. "Decomposition" or a confirmed laboratory result), and the date published, with the FDA page and a verbatim quote. Record IDs come from resolve_firm or list_alert_firms.
name: get_listing

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

notes.description: FDA's stated reason for the listing.

product_code.description: FDA's product code line as printed.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.
